description: A gentle hand-painted cream pug with dark chocolate ears and muzzle, round black eyes, short splayed legs, and a curled tail.
baseSceneNotes: Puglet is one compact handmade cream pug with a broad low body, flat round face, dark brown ears and muzzle, short legs, and a connected curled tail.
The orange source background and lower-right signature are excluded.
Look directions use the original eye patches, eyes, muzzle, head, ears, and tail follow-through; the whole sprite does not rotate.

idle.notes: Quiet breathing and blink loop with planted paws.

walk.notes: Short-leg directional drag movement with the curled tail following.

curious.notes: Focused head tilt and eye attention without new props.

sleep.notes: Expectant asking pose for approval or user input.

hop.notes: Vertical anticipation, lift, peak, descent, and settle.

melancholy.notes: Slumped, sad reaction with no detached effects.

active.notes: Focused non-locomotion task-processing loop without props.

lookDirections.mechanics: Lower paws and torso stay anchored; original eyes, face, muzzle, head, ears, and tail follow the gaze continuously.

dragFacingValidation.rule: deltaX < 0 => facing left; deltaX > 0 => facing right
manualVerification: left drag uses the true left-facing gait row
right drag uses the true right-facing gait row
Puglet has no handed prop whose meaning changes under mirroring
the curled tail stays connected and the face remains recognizable at small size
